svg.title: Skills
svg.desc: Languages: Rust, Go, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, Swift, Objective-C, Dart, C, C++, Kotlin, Java, SQL, HTML, CSS. Core Domains: Reversing, Binary Analysis, Software Protection, Vulnerability Research. Low-Level Specialization: Assembly Analysis, Devirtualization, Deobfuscation, Dynamic Instrumentation. Platforms & Security Areas: Mobile Security, API Security, WebAssembly, DLL / Dylib Engineering. Applied Engineering: AI / ML, Data Automation, API Development, Cloudflare Workers. Product & Interface Work: UI / UX, Prompt Engineering, Social Media Bots, MQL5 / Trading Systems. Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind, Vite, Webpack, Dart, React Native, Flutter. Backend: Node.js, Express, NestJS, FastAPI, Flask, Django, .NET, GraphQL. Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQLite, MySQL, Redis, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Firebase. Tools: Git, Linux, Docker, Postman, VS Code, Jupyter, GitHub, npm. Software: IDA Pro, Ghidra, Binary Ninja, Frida, x64dbg, Hopper, LLDB, Wireshark. Cloud & Infra: Cloudflare Workers, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Nginx, Snowflake.
